author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted - Paid Opportunities
content:
HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES

Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027.

If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work.

Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required.

These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor. We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork. (Yes, we're aware AI art has appeared on our channel before, and we'd love to return to using human artists full-time once the budget supports it, and this is part of that plan.) 

Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability:

Email: craiggroshek [at] https://t.co/huxOivDeXU
Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST

Know a talented artist who would be a great fit? Tag them below or share this post to help us find them!

#ChillingTalesForDarkNights #HorrorArt #HorrorIllustration #ArtistsWanted #PaidArtOpportunities

author: Shiny
title: Minecraft Pixel Artists Wanted - Paid Opportunity
content:
MINECRAFT PIXEL ARTISTS WANTED! PAID OPPORTUNITY!

I'm looking for talented Pixel Artists and Animated Pixel Art Designers to help revive one of Minecraft's most challenging dimension mods!

The Abyss II, a Minecraft mod with over 10 MILLION downloads on CurseForge, is making a comeback!

I'm currently working on porting the mod to NeoForge 26.3, but I want to do much more than just update it. The entire dimension, including its blocks, items, magical equipment, and visual effects, needs a massive overhaul!

And that's where YOU come in!

What I'm offering:
A generous budget and paid commissions!
Project revenue shares through CurseForge!
Full credits and attribution in the mod and on CurseForge!

I'm especially looking for experienced Minecraft artists who know how to work with seamless tiling textures, connected textures, animated textures, and particle effects.

I have a substantial budget for this project and want to work with passionate artists who know the Minecraft modding community!

Interested? Drop your portfolio in the replies or reach out to me directly!

And if you know any talented Minecraft Pixel Artists, please tag them or repost this so they can see it!

IMPORTANT: NO AI-GENERATED ART!

Hey @CurseForge if you see this repost it! We love each other right?

Check out The Abyss II:
https://t.co/8lBuaR4AAk

#Minecraft #PixelArt #MinecraftMods #CurseForge
